rust_summary: a client's own menus over the game's: screens a mod draws itself (`native_screen_claim`), a top overlay on every screen, the title included (`native_overlay`), and input it hears first (`native_overlay_input`). A backdrop of its own in place of the panorama (`native_backdrop_claim`, `native_backdrop`), and a GUI skin over the game's sprites by name (`hud::set_skin`). Helpers: `native_ui_screen`, `native_open`, `native_connect`, `native_canvas_upload` (the `horizon/mod-canvas` atlas slot), `native_sprite_tinted`, `native_text_scaled`, `native_clip_since`, `native_gui_scale`, `native_player_name`.
doc_summary: a client's own menus over the game's (`native_screen_claim`, `native_overlay`, `native_overlay_input`) and the helpers they drive the game with.
